name: color.gray.0
description: Neutral ramp step 0, the darkest. Backs color.bg-canvas. Do not use in components; use the semantic token.

name: color.gray.1
description: Neutral ramp step 1. Backs color.bg and color.text-inverse. Do not use in components; use the semantic token.

name: color.gray.2
description: Neutral ramp step 2. Backs color.surface. Do not use in components; use the semantic token.

name: color.gray.3
description: Neutral ramp step 3. Backs color.surface-raised. Do not use in components; use the semantic token.

name: color.gray.4
description: Neutral ramp step 4. Backs color.surface-hover. Do not use in components; use the semantic token.

name: color.gray.5
description: Neutral ramp step 5. Backs color.line. Do not use in components; use the semantic token.

name: color.gray.6
description: Neutral ramp step 6. Backs color.line-strong. Do not use in components; use the semantic token.

name: color.gray.7
description: Neutral ramp step 7, the dimmest readable gray. Backs color.text-3. Lightened from #7A7A82 (TOK-004) so it reaches 4.5:1 on every surface up to surface-hover. Do not use in components; use the semantic token.

name: color.gray.8
description: Neutral ramp step 8. Backs color.text-2. Do not use in components; use the semantic token.

name: color.gray.9
description: Neutral ramp step 9, the lightest (warm off-white, never pure white). Backs color.text and color.primary-bg. Do not use in components; use the semantic token.

name: color.blue.5
description: Signal blue. Backs color.accent. Do not use in components; use the semantic token.

name: color.green.5
description: Signal green. Backs color.success. Do not use in components; use the semantic token.

name: color.amber.5
description: Signal amber. Backs color.warning. Do not use in components; use the semantic token.

name: color.red.5
description: Signal red. Backs color.danger. Do not use in components; use the semantic token.

name: color.bg-canvas
description: Page canvas behind the app shell (the html element). The darkest layer. Not for cards or controls.

name: color.bg
description: Default app background (body, top bar, main area). One step above the canvas. Not for cards; use surface.

name: color.surface
description: Cards, panels, table bodies and inputs at rest. Move one layer at a time: bg, surface, surface-raised, surface-hover.

name: color.surface-raised
description: Menus, popovers, selected rows and anything floating above a surface. Not for page backgrounds.

name: color.surface-hover
description: Hover state of controls and list items: one step lighter than the resting surface. Do not use at rest.

name: color.surface-row-hover
description: Hover background of table and list rows only; subtler than surface-hover so dense data stays calm. Not for buttons or menu items.

name: color.line-subtle
description: Internal dividers inside a card or table (row separators). Decorative, so exempt from the 3:1 non-text contrast rule. Never use it as a control boundary.

name: color.line
description: Default 1px border of cards and containers. Not for form control boundaries; use line-control.

name: color.line-strong
description: Border of overlays, menus, popovers, dialogs and cards that must stand out. Not for form control boundaries (use line-control); it is below 3:1.

name: color.line-control
description: Boundary of form controls: input, select, textarea, checkbox, radio and combobox triggers. At least 3:1 on bg, surface and surface-raised (WCAG 1.4.11). New in TOK-004. Not for decorative dividers.

name: color.text
description: Primary text and icons. Warm off-white, not pure white. Use for anything that must be read first.

name: color.text-2
description: Secondary text: descriptions, supporting copy, inactive labels.

name: color.text-3
description: Tertiary text: metadata, placeholders, hints. Meets 4.5:1 on every surface up to surface-hover. Do not use on surfaces lighter than surface-hover or on colored fills.

name: color.text-inverse
description: Text and icons on solid light or signal fills (selected day in a calendar, solid badges). Not on dark surfaces.

name: color.primary-bg
description: Fill of the primary button and the tooltip: light ink on a dark UI. One primary action per screen. Hover is brightness .88, not a new token.

name: color.primary-fg
description: Text and icons on primary-bg.

name: color.primary-fg-muted
description: Secondary text on primary-bg (for example the shortcut hint in a tooltip). Only valid on primary-bg.

name: color.accent
description: The single accent: focus, selection, links and open states. Never a button fill or a large area. Always pair with text or a shape, never color alone.

name: color.success
description: Success signal: done, saved, healthy. Always accompanied by text or an icon. Not decorative.

name: color.warning
description: Warning signal: attention needed, nothing broken. Always accompanied by text or an icon.

name: color.danger
description: Error and destructive signal: errors, delete buttons, invalid fields. Always accompanied by text or an icon.

name: color.accent-soft
description: Tinted background for accent states (selected item, info). 14% accent over the surface beneath, resolved with color-mix so it adapts to the surface. Not for text.

name: color.success-soft
description: Tinted background for success states (badge, banner). 14% success over the surface beneath. Not for text.

name: color.warning-soft
description: Tinted background for warning states (badge, banner). 14% warning over the surface beneath. Not for text.

name: color.danger-soft
description: Tinted background for error states (badge, banner, invalid field). 10% danger over the surface beneath. Not for text.

name: color.danger-soft-hover
description: Hover state of danger-soft surfaces such as the ghost-danger button. 18% danger over the surface beneath.

name: color.danger-line
description: Border of danger-tinted surfaces (error banner, destructive confirmation). 35% danger over the surface beneath. Not a form control boundary; invalid fields use danger.

name: color.overlay
description: Backdrop behind dialogs. Flat, no blur. Not for side sheets; use scrim.

name: color.scrim
description: Backdrop behind side sheets. Lighter than overlay so the page stays visible. Not for dialogs.

name: color.swatch-ring
description: Inset 1px ring drawn inside color swatches and avatars so dark swatches stay visible on dark surfaces. Not a general border.

name: color.paper
description: Paper surface of printed-document previews (receipt, PDF). The only light surface in the system; use inside [data-theme="paper"] only.

name: color.paper-ink
description: Primary text on paper. Paper theme only.

name: color.paper-ink-2
description: Secondary text on paper. Paper theme only.

name: color.paper-muted
description: Tertiary text and control boundaries on paper (above 4.5:1 on paper). Paper theme only.

name: color.paper-rule
description: Decorative rules and dividers on paper (table lines, totals). Below 3:1, so never a control boundary or text. Paper theme only.

name: color.paper-accent
description: Accent on paper: links and highlighted figures (4.53:1 on paper). Darkened from #B8603E in TOK-004. Paper theme only.

name: focus-ring
description: Focus halo: 3px ring, 25% accent over the surface beneath, used as box-shadow next to an accent border. base.css adds a transparent outline so focus stays visible in forced-colors mode. Not a hover or selected style.

name: focus-ring-danger
description: Focus halo for invalid fields: 3px ring, 25% danger over the surface beneath. Use instead of focus-ring when the control is in an error state. Not a general error style.

name: font.sans
description: UI font stack: self-hosted Geist, then a metric-matched Arial fallback face, then the system font. Use for all interface text. Not for numbers, codes or data (use font.mono).

name: font.mono
description: Data font stack: self-hosted Geist Mono with a metric-matched fallback. Use for numbers, codes, amounts, shortcuts and uppercase group captions. Pair with tabular-nums. Not for running text.

name: weight.regular
description: Regular weight (400): body text, descriptions, mono data.

name: weight.medium
description: Medium weight (500): labels, chips, mono captions. Not for body paragraphs.

name: weight.semibold
description: Semibold weight (600): display, title and heading. The heaviest weight in use; do not add bold (700).

name: fs.display
description: Display font size (34px, line 40px, tracking -2%, semibold). Hero statement; at most once per screen. Minimum font size in the system is 11.5px (caption); never go below it.

name: fs.title
description: Title font size (22px, line 30px, tracking -1%, semibold). Page and section titles. Minimum font size in the system is 11.5px (caption); never go below it.

name: fs.heading
description: Heading font size (17px, line 24px, semibold). Dialog titles and card headings. Minimum font size in the system is 11.5px (caption); never go below it.

name: fs.body
description: Body font size (15px, line 24px, regular). Default running text; the base size of the app. Minimum font size in the system is 11.5px (caption); never go below it.

name: fs.small
description: Small font size (14px, line 22px, regular). Descriptions, helper text and table cells. Minimum font size in the system is 11.5px (caption); never go below it.

name: fs.label
description: Label font size (13px, line 18px, medium). Field labels, chips and compact buttons. Minimum font size in the system is 11.5px (caption); never go below it.

name: fs.meta
description: Meta font size (12px, line 16px, mono regular). Dates, phone numbers and counts next to titles. Minimum font size in the system is 11.5px (caption); never go below it.

name: fs.caption
description: Caption font size (11.5px, line 16px, mono medium, uppercase, +8% tracking). FLOOR of the type scale: no token or component may use a smaller size. Group captions and table headers.

name: fs.num
description: Number font size for indicator figures (24px, line 32px, mono medium). Use with tabular-nums. Minimum font size in the system is 11.5px (caption); never go below it.

name: fs.num-lg
description: Number font size for highlighted totals such as a balance (30px, line 36px, mono medium). Use with tabular-nums. Minimum font size in the system is 11.5px (caption); never go below it.

name: fs.icon
description: Font size of text glyphs inside icon-only buttons (for example the multiplication sign and chevrons), 20px. Not for SVG icons; use size.icon-*.

name: lh.display
description: Line height for fs.display (40px).

name: lh.title
description: Line height for fs.title (30px).

name: lh.heading
description: Line height for fs.heading (24px).

name: lh.body
description: Line height for fs.body (24px, ratio 1.6).

name: lh.small
description: Line height for fs.small (22px).

name: lh.label
description: Line height for fs.label (18px).

name: lh.meta
description: Line height for fs.meta (16px).

name: lh.caption
description: Line height for fs.caption (16px).

name: lh.num
description: Line height for fs.num (32px).

name: lh.num-lg
description: Line height for fs.num-lg (36px).

name: tracking.display
description: Letter spacing for display: -2% of 34px = -0.68px. DTCG dimensions have no em unit, so the exact px equivalent is stored. Use only with fs.display.

name: tracking.title
description: Letter spacing for title: -1% of 22px = -0.22px. Use only with fs.title.

name: tracking.caption
description: Letter spacing for caption: +8% of 11.5px = 0.92px. Use only with fs.caption and uppercase.

name: typography.display
description: Display role: 34/40, semibold, -2% tracking. Composite for documentation and design tools; CSS uses the individual fs, lh and weight variables.

name: typography.title
description: Title role: 22/30, semibold, -1% tracking. Composite for documentation and design tools; CSS uses the individual fs, lh and weight variables.

name: typography.heading
description: Heading role: 17/24, semibold. Composite for documentation and design tools; CSS uses the individual fs, lh and weight variables.

name: typography.body
description: Body role: 15/24, regular. Composite for documentation and design tools; CSS uses the individual fs, lh and weight variables.

name: typography.small
description: Small role: 14/22, regular. Composite for documentation and design tools; CSS uses the individual fs, lh and weight variables.

name: typography.label
description: Label role: 13/18, medium. Composite for documentation and design tools; CSS uses the individual fs, lh and weight variables.

name: typography.meta
description: Meta role: 12/16, mono regular. Composite for documentation and design tools; CSS uses the individual fs, lh and weight variables.

name: typography.caption
description: Caption role: 11.5/16, mono medium, uppercase (text-transform applied in CSS), +8% tracking. Floor of the scale. Composite for documentation and design tools; CSS uses the individual fs, lh and weight variables.

name: typography.num
description: Indicator number role: 24/32, mono medium, tabular-nums. Composite for documentation and design tools; CSS uses the individual fs, lh and weight variables.

name: typography.num-lg
description: Highlight number role: 30/36, mono medium, tabular-nums. Composite for documentation and design tools; CSS uses the individual fs, lh and weight variables.

name: space.1
description: Space step 1 (4px): the grid unit. Icon-to-text gaps and tight padding.

name: space.2
description: Space step 2 (8px). Default gap between related elements inside a component.

name: space.3
description: Space step 3 (12px). Compact padding and form field gaps.

name: space.4
description: Space step 4 (16px). Standard padding and gap between components.

name: space.5
description: Space step 5 (20px). Card padding.

name: space.6
description: Space step 6 (24px). Gap between sections inside a page.

name: space.8
description: Space step 8 (32px). Large section separation.

name: space.12
description: Space step 12 (48px). Page-level separation.

name: space.16
description: Space step 16 (64px). Largest spacing; hero and empty-state breathing room.

name: size.control-h-sm
description: Height of small controls (32px). Dense toolbars. Must still meet the 24px minimum target (size.target-min).

name: size.control-h-md
description: Height of default controls (40px): buttons, inputs, selects. The handoff --control-h.

name: size.control-h-lg
description: Height of large controls (48px): primary actions and touch-first forms.

name: size.item-h
description: Height of menu items, navigation items and listbox options (36px).

name: size.row-h
description: Height of table and list rows (52px).

name: size.row-h-dense
description: Height of dense rows with two lines of content (60px). Taller than row-h because it holds more content.

name: size.sidebar-w
description: Width of the app sidebar (240px).

name: size.topbar-h
description: Height of the top bar (64px).

name: size.icon-xs
description: Icon size extra small (12px): inline status glyphs, chevrons in chips.

name: size.icon-sm
description: Icon size small (14px): icons inside dense controls.

name: size.icon-md
description: Icon size medium (18px): default icon beside text and in nav items.

name: size.icon-lg
description: Icon size large (20px): icon-only buttons and empty states.

name: size.target-min
description: Minimum interactive target size (24px, WCAG 2.5.8). No interactive element may be smaller in either dimension.

name: radius.sm
description: Small radius (4px): chips, menu items, checkboxes.

name: radius.md
description: Medium radius (6px): buttons and inputs. The handoff --radius.

name: radius.lg
description: Large radius (10px): cards, menus, popovers, dialogs.

name: radius.pill
description: Pill radius (999px): badges and switches. Any very large value renders fully round; do not use on large rectangles.

name: shadow.overlay
description: Shadow for floating overlays: menus, popovers, toasts. The only elevation besides dialog. Never on cards or inline elements.

name: shadow.dialog
description: Shadow for dialogs and side sheets: the highest elevation. Never on inline elements.

name: motion.duration
description: Standard transition duration (150ms): hover, focus and state changes. Only color, opacity and position. Neutralized under prefers-reduced-motion.

name: motion.duration-done
description: Completion feedback duration (320ms): subtle check or fill when something is done. No confetti.

name: motion.duration-progress
description: Duration of progress bar fill changes (300ms). Neutralized under prefers-reduced-motion.

name: motion.ease
description: Standard easing, cubic-bezier(.2, 0, 0, 1): fast start, soft landing. Use with every transition.

name: z.dropdown
description: Layer of dropdowns, selects, comboboxes and date pickers. Above page content, below popovers.

name: z.popover
description: Layer of popovers and action menus. Above dropdowns.

name: z.sheet
description: Layer of side sheets. The scrim uses this value and the panel uses this value + 1 (calc).

name: z.dialog
description: Layer of dialogs and their overlay. Above sheets, because a dialog can open from a sheet.

name: z.toast
description: Layer of toasts. Above dialogs so confirmations stay visible; below tooltips.

name: z.tooltip
description: Layer of tooltips. The highest layer in the system. Do not add layers above it.

name: opacity.disabled
description: Opacity of disabled controls. One value for every component (the handoff .4 and .45 are unified). Disabled elements are exempt from contrast rules. Not for decorative fading.
